name: medbourse
description: MEDBOURSE — education, medical tourism, and travel platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @medbourse/api" "npm run dev -w @medbourse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @medbourse/shared && npm run build -w @medbourse/api && npm run build -w @medbourse/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @medbourse/api && npm run lint -w @medbourse/web
